summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 384 Chinese source units, all 16 temporal or active-hint items, and all four people. This is a technical calendrical treatise. Its opening dates the calendar epoch to Yuanyou 7 (AD 1092), but the only passage naming Wu Ze, Wu Shiju, Cheng Xi, and Zhang Wenjin is an undated textual-variant note. The calendar epoch cannot be silently transferred into a date of any named person's editorial, copying, or witness activity. All current personal date claims and hints therefore remain source-specific research holds pending independent dated provenance; no source or canonical extraction was changed.

evidence.quote: 演紀上元甲子，距元祐七年壬申，歲積五百九十四萬四千八百八算。
